items.description:
Luggage refer to international air transport agreement. 
Cabin = 8 kg and 55 x 40 x 23 cm.
Checked = 23 kg and max liner size 158 cm.

subOrderContent.description: in case one or several nodes is built from a subOrder in clients system these ordernumbers can be placed here. Observe that the same suborder number may occur in several nodes and the suborder therefore may consists of several nodes. The system of the provider can store these orders separately and can by using message 2040 tell the client its corresponding ordernumbers
